title: CBW Affiliate Campaign and Offer Model V1
description: Models affiliate campaigns, links, redirect observations, offers and public verification levels. Contains NO real affiliate URLs, referral codes, secrets or bonus amounts. All example values use the reserved example.invalid domain and clearly fake placeholders.
safetyNote: Public verification is anonymous L0-L3 only. L4 (account-confirmed) is a separately authorized future capability and is never performed without an explicit owner authorization. No account creation, login, KYC, proxy, location spoofing or financial transaction is described or permitted.

fields.internalRedirectSlug: managed internal slug, e.g. go/binance-kz-example (identity only; no live route is created by this architecture)

invariants: affiliate route changes are owner-gated; ownerApprovedRoute defaults false
no real destination URL or referral code is stored in this architecture model
referralIdentifierPlaceholder MUST be an obvious placeholder, never a real code

fields.hopChain: array of {hop: integer, urlPlaceholder: string, httpStatus: integer}
fields.snapshotObjectKey: object-store key for the captured chain and screenshot

invariants: redirect chains are captured anonymously without cookies tied to a real identity

fields.offerHeadlinePlaceholder: e.g. up to <PLACEHOLDER> reward (exact value only after L2 capture)

invariants: headline language MUST use 'up to' style, never a guaranteed reward claim
no concrete bonus amount is stored in this architecture model

fields.termType: one of [ELIGIBILITY, WAGERING, TIME_WINDOW, GEO, KYC_REQUIRED]

catalog.definition: Redirect chain resolved anonymously to a final destination domain.
Public offer page captured with snapshot and hash.
Public terms and eligibility captured and cross-checked against official pages.
Reward confirmed via a real account. Not performed without explicit separate owner authorization; involves no automation, proxy or fake identity.

fields.outcome: one of [CONFIRMED, CHANGED, BROKEN, GEO_BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE]

invariants: a BROKEN_LINK or SUSPENDED offer MUST force ctaState SUPPRESSED_BROKEN
a GEO_RESTRICTED offer for the market MUST force ctaState SUPPRESSED_GEO
any ENABLED transition on a live CTA is owner-gated
